# Orbid AI Help Center — full documentation map

## Entity

| Field | Value |
|-------|--------|
| Name | Orbid AI |
| Formerly | MedStrato |
| Type | Native AI agent for medical-device tender (bid) operations |
| Core loop | Scan → Match → Fill → Deliver |
| Human owns | Judgment, pricing, RA/legal sign-off, buyer submission |
| Product | https://orbid.dev |
| Canonical docs host | https://docs.orbid.dev |
| Content/SEO host (aux) | https://medstrato.com |
